QuestInfo.name: Back Alley Shadows
QuestInfo.0:
The outsiders have been spotted at the outskirts of the village!
Talk with a member of the Beggar Guild to learn their exact location.
QuestInfo.1: The outsiders have appeared! Their last known location was the warehouse at the outskirts of the village.
QuestInfo.2:
You rescued your fellow students from the burning warehouse. 
They mentioned that members of a syndicate that can wield sorcery were here. In fact, Yun Wu went with them. 
You should give chase!
